blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Sacred Heart School-Ateneo de Cebu (SHS-AdC) Magis Eagles remained unbeaten in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 high school basketball tournament after drubbing the Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) Junior Wildcats, 64-42, on Tuesday, October 6, at the Cebu Coliseum. The Magis Eagles stretched their winning streak to five games as they continued their march toward a rare seven-peat championship. SHS-AdC wasted little time asserting its dominance, opening the game with an 11-1 run and taking a commanding 36-14 lead into halftime.
